id.description: Unique identifier for this provider instance. Used when generating keys to specify which provider to use.

description.description: Human-readable description of this provider instance.
description.example: Production HashiCorp Vault for signing keys

baseUrl.description: Base URL of the remote KMS microservice (no trailing slash). Supports ${ENV_VAR} placeholders.

auth.description: Authentication method for the remote KMS service. Supports bearer token, OAuth 2.0 client credentials, and mutual TLS. Omit (or set type to "none") for unauthenticated services.

keysPath.description: Path prefix for key endpoints on the remote service. Defaults to /keys.

healthPath.description: Path for the health check endpoint on the remote service. Defaults to /health.

canImport.description: Whether the remote service supports key import via POST {keysPath}/{kid}/import. Defaults to false.
